title: Monkey with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='42' r='12' fill='#c97b1e'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='42' r='12' fill='#c97b1e'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='42' r='7' fill='#f2b56b'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='42' r='7' fill='#f2b56b'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='30' ry='28' fill='#a85f00'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#f2c58a'/>
  <!-- forehead highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='16' ry='6' fill='#c97b1e'/>
  <!-- eyes whites -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='43' r='8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='43' r='8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='5' fill='#4a2800'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='5' fill='#4a2800'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars in eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='41' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='41' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle rays -->
  <line x1='39' y1='39' x2='36' y2='36' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='45' y1='40' x2='47' y2='37' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='40' x2='53' y2='37' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='61' y1='39' x2='64' y2='36' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a4b00'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='53' r='1' fill='#c97b1e'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='53' r='1' fill='#c97b1e'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M42 60 Q50 68 58 60' stroke='#8a4b00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smile cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='54' r='4' fill='#f2a0a0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='54' r='4' fill='#f2a0a0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- top tuft -->
  <path d='M44 18 Q50 8 56 18' fill='#a85f00'/>
  <path d='M50 16 Q54 10 58 16' fill='#c97b1e'/>
</svg>
